# POKER MACHINE - Tony Horncastle - DREAMER 17 PDF p.61 (census said ~49-50)
# Printed range "( 0080 - 0400 )": rows printed 0090-00D5, 0200-03FF. 0080-008F not printed
# (variables: 0083-0085 = current holds, zero-filled here); 0100-01FF is the display RAM.
# load 0080-03FF, run C000 (CHIP-8).
# "This is a 3-Reel poker machine. Any three of a kind pays. One or more reels may be held
# provided none were held last spin and there was no payout."
# Keys: 0 spin, 1/2/3 hold reel 1/2/3 (an H appears under the reel), C cancel holds.
# Credits start at 41 (6D29), each spin costs 1; three of a kind pays 75/50/25/20/15/10/5
# by symbol (rarest pays most). Left score = credits, right = last win.
# With 0 credits the program executes 03AE F100, an invalid opcode: CHIPOS returns to the
# monitor (game over) - kept as printed.
